'''Rishal''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Rish]] in the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]]. Located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], it was a barren, lifeless world that couldn't support life, but was rich in metal and ores. Rishal had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].
